data.notes: November is lighter than peak Zamna season, but confirmed programming still centers on Day of the Dead, beach/jungle club nights, and a major Riviera Maya destination EDM festival.

events.title: Ember Shores 2026
events.summary: ILLENIUM’s destination festival returns to the Riviera Maya for three days at Barceló Riviera Maya Resort, with multiple stages and a large electronic support lineup.

events.title: PPP Presents UMBRAL: Music Journey by Stavroz (Live)
events.summary: Papaya Playa Project’s UMBRAL Día de Muertos program includes a November 1 live music journey by Stavroz, billed around organic rhythms, warm melodies and deep tropical groove.

events.title: Full Moon Rising
events.summary: Gitano Beach’s Full Moon Rising is its confirmed November full-moon party, advertised with electronic music and DJ sets on the beach from 8 PM until late.

events.title: Papaya Playa Project Presents The Full Moon
events.summary: Papaya Playa Project’s November 21 Full Moon party is a beachfront electronic night billed around deep grooves and late-night dancing; the lineup is listed as TBA.

events.title: 11 Years of Proper Collective
events.summary: Proper Collective’s 11-year anniversary in Tulum, listed on RA’s house calendar; the collective is rooted in underground house culture, deep/minimal house, long-form sets, and intimate community-focused dance floors.

events.title: Gypsy Disco
events.summary: Gitano’s long-running Friday Gypsy Disco pairs dinner, mezcal cocktails and local DJs playing disco, funk, groove and nu-disco in the Jungle Room.

events.title: SOSrec Showcase Tulum
events.summary: SOS Productions takes over Obsidiana Tulum’s rooftop for a vinyl-only house and minimal night with Nomad and Guille Sola.

events.title: LA NOCHE
events.summary: Gitano Beach’s dinner-to-dance Latin beats and Afro house night, with salsa class options, cabaret/show elements, open-bar and dinner packages, and late beachfront dancing.

events.title: Gypsy Disco Especial Edition
events.summary: Special edition of Gitano Jungle’s Friday Gypsy Disco format, built around local DJs, disco, funk, groove and nu-disco, with dinner, cocktails, table service and a gradual build from social dining into dancing.

events.title: Concert Night | HANAL PIXÁN
events.summary: Vesica Cenote hosts a candlelit Hanal Pixán concert night with live Mexican music and a collective Day of the Dead altar beside the cenote.

events.title: PPP Presents - UMBRAL Dia de Muertos
events.summary: UMBRAL is a contemporary Day of the Dead celebration at Papaya Playa Project, with ritual, culture, community programming and a Saturday night celebration featuring international DJs. The event page lists the program as taking place October 25 to November 2, overlapping the first days of November.

events.title: Tulum Crypto Fest 2026
events.summary: Tulum Crypto Fest is a four-day culture-and-networking conference with confirmed festival parties, an opening party and a November 28 Full Moon Party described as a music-focused celebration. No artist lineup is listed yet on the ticket page.
